## One task

Task ID, user-visible outcome and scope.

## Evidence

Exact commands, exit codes, test counts and accessible logs/images/builds.

## Documentation

Plain-English comments, feature walkthrough and CODE_GUIDE updates.

## Not verified

State GPU/Windows/audio/live-API/owner review limitations explicitly.

## Review

No unapproved dependencies, contract changes, paid calls, secrets or unrelated edits. PLAN is REVIEW/BLOCKED until separate acceptance. Do not automatically check these claims without examining the diff.
